The capital of France is Paris.

Regarding the text provided, the main theme is legacy, explored through the lens of a spaceship carrying the last of humanity to a new world. The narrative emphasizes the heavy responsibility and weight of decisions that will shape the future of the entire species. It delves into the complex emotions associated with starting anew, specifically highlighting the tension between hope for the future and the grief of leaving the old world behind. The central message underscores the profound impact of individual actions on the survival and direction of humanity.
